title: Guess the Capital of the Country 🔴 LIVE – type it in chat!
description:
🏛️ Guess the capital of the country and type it in the LIVE CHAT – 24/7!
🌍 Every round shows a country with its flag and shape. Stuck? Hints unlock over time: the first letter, a dot where the capital is, then the last letter – and on TRICKY rounds we tell you which big city it is NOT. Letters appear one by one.

HOW TO PLAY
1. Look at the country.
2. Type its capital in the chat. The stream runs a few seconds behind, so just type when you know it.
3. Everyone who's right scores: 1st = 10, 2nd = 7, 3rd = 5, everyone else 3 points.
4. Type ! and your country (e.g. !germany) to get your flag next to your name.

🏆 TOP PLAYERS TODAY: the best guessers of the day, live on screen.
🧩 More live games (Guess the Country by Its Shape, Guess the Word by Emoji): youtube.com/channel/UCG6xEYtopZcK66gz_biiIIA/streams

Map data: Natural Earth (public domain).
Be kind in the chat – names are shown on stream.

#guessthecapital #geography #livestream
chatHint: 🏛️ Know the capital? Type it in the chat – everyone who's right scores! Add your flag with ! + your country (e.g. !brazil).
